description: Find airports within a radius of a latitude/longitude, ranked nearest-first by great-circle distance, each with its distance (km) and bearing (degrees true) from the query point. The grounding tool for "nearest airport to here" — pair it with a live aviation server to fetch weather or positions for the result. Takes a coordinate only: no geocoding, so resolve place names to lat/lon upstream first (e.g. an OpenStreetMap or Open-Meteo geocode tool). Closed airports are excluded unless include_closed is set. totalCount is the in-radius match count before limit; a capped result says so. OurAirports is community-edited — not authoritative for flight operations.

include_closed.description: Include airports of type "closed". Off by default.

latitude.description: Query point latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), −90 to 90.

limit.description: Maximum airports to return (1–50). Defaults to OURAIRPORTS_DEFAULT_SEARCH_LIMIT (20).

longitude.description: Query point longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), −180 to 180.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers (1–500). Defaults to 100.

type.description: Restrict to one airport type (e.g. large_airport for major fields only).

name: ourairports_find_airports

items.description: An airport with its great-circle distance and bearing from the query point.

airport.description: The airport record. Codes the airport lacks are null.

continent.description: Two-letter continent code (AF, AN, AS, EU, NA, OC, SA), or null.

countryName.description: Resolved country name, or null when the country code is unknown.

elevationFt.description: Field elevation in feet, or null when unknown.

iataCode.description: 3-letter IATA code, or null when the airport has none (~89% of fields).

icaoCode.description: 4-letter ICAO code, or null when the airport has none (~88% of fields).

id.description: OurAirports internal integer id (the join key for runways/frequencies).

ident.description: OurAirports universal identifier — globally unique; often equals the ICAO or GPS code.

isoCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or null.

isoRegion.description: ISO 3166-2 region code (e.g. US-WA), or null.

localCode.description: National/local code (e.g. FAA LID), or null.

regionName.description: Resolved region name, or null when the region code is unknown.

scheduledService.description: True when the airport has scheduled airline service.

type.description: Airport type: large_airport, medium_airport, small_airport, heliport, seaplane_base, balloonport, or closed.

bearingDeg.description: Initial bearing from the query point in degrees true (0–360, clockwise from north).

distanceKm.description: Great-circle distance from the query point in kilometers.

cap.description: The limit that was applied. Present only when results were truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when no airport fell within the radius or results were capped — how to widen or narrow.

shown.description: Number of airports returned. Present only when results were truncated.

totalCount.description: Airports within the radius that pass the type and include_closed filters, counted before the limit was applied.

truncated.description: Present and true only when more airports matched than were returned.

title: ourairports-mcp-server
